name: OKC_CLAUSE_DEVIATIONS_T
description: As the Contract Deviations are generated each time the user chooses to view them, they are stored in this table. This is to account for any change to the document directly. The user should also be able to indicate his/her preference to generate the Contract Deviations report and attach it in the approval workflow notification.

columns.name: CLS_SEQUENCE_ID
columns.description: The colum which holds the unique index for every run of the deviation report.

columns.name: SCN_ID
columns.description: The Section ID for the Clause

columns.name: ARTICLE_ID
columns.description: Clause ID on the business document

columns.name: ARTICLE_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Clause Version ID on the business document

columns.name: REF_ARTICLE_ID
columns.description: Ref Clause ID populated when a Std Clause is made non std

columns.name: DISPLAY_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Display sequence for sections on deviations summary page.

columns.name: STANDARD_FLAG
columns.description: Required when Expert Data is dumped

columns.name: ORIG_ARTICLE_ID
columns.description: Original Clause ID in case of Alternate Clause

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
